verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's own write API documents bulk operations across many documents. Patch-by-filter and delete-by-filter act on every document matching a filter, column-based upserts write many rows in one request, and long-running server-side copies can run in the background with async handling. missing for 10: documented batch-size limits or throughput for bulk writes, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk-operation behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Patch by filter: patches documents that match a filter. Delete by filter: deletes documents that match a filter.
Upserts documents in a column-based format. This field is an object, where each key is the name of a column
Copies are performed entirely server-side... Copies work across regions and across cloud providers (e.g., AWS to GCP).
Send the `Prefer: respond-async` header to allow the server to start the operation in the background.
